import pandas as pd

# Load source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/training_1.csv"

# Read CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation History: JOIN on ["movieId", "movieId"]
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Transformations to match target schema and types:
# Target schema: ['userId': int, 'movieId': int, 'rating': float, 'timestamp': int,
#                 'title': string, 'genres': string, 'genres_arr': string, 'genre_count': string]

# Ensure correct dtypes
df_joined['userId'] = df_joined['userId'].astype(int)
df_joined['movieId'] = df_joined['movieId'].astype(int)
df_joined['rating'] = df_joined['rating'].astype(float)
df_joined['timestamp'] = df_joined['timestamp'].astype(int)
df_joined['title'] = df_joined['title'].astype(str)
df_joined['genres'] = df_joined['genres'].astype(str)

# Create 'genres_arr' column: list of genres as string representation of Python list
df_joined['genres_arr'] = df_joined['genres'].apply(lambda x: str(x.split('|')))

# Create 'genre_count' column: the first genre in the genres list (as per examples)
df_joined['genre_count'] = df_joined['genres'].apply(lambda x: x.split('|')[0] if x else '')

# Reorder columns to match target schema
df_target = df_joined[['userId', 'movieId', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'title', 'genres', 'genres_arr', 'genre_count']]

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on movieId (inner join to keep only matching movieIds)
result = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="movieId", how="inner")

# The target schema is:
# ['userId': integer, 'movieId': integer, 'rating': float, 'timestamp': integer, 'title': string, 'genres': string, 'genres_arr': string, 'genre_count': string]

# Create genres_arr by splitting genres string on '|'
result["genres_arr"] = result["genres"].str.split("|")

# Create genre_count as the first genre in genres_arr (string)
result["genre_count"] = result["genres_arr"].str[0]

# Ensure column order matches target schema exactly
result = result[["userId", "movieId", "rating", "timestamp", "title", "genres", "genres_arr", "genre_count"]]

# Write to output CSV without the index
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_15/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
